units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 8a:17">M. Kat. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>כד הדר ס׳ וכ׳</he> whenever, in Palestine, a wailer comes around, they say, let all those who are of a bitter heart (mourning for a relative) weep with him (engage him for wailing).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:2">Ib. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>פתח עליה ההוא ס׳</he> the wailer on the occasion began thus; <cite ref="Chagigah 15b:4">Ḥag. 15ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סַפְדָּנַיָּא</he>, <he>סַפְדָּנֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Taanit 5b:9">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי בכדי בכו בכייא וספדו ס׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M., was it for nought that the weepers wept, and the wailers wailed &c.? <cite ref="Yevamot 121b:12">Yeb. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>כן וכן ס׳ הוו התם</he> such and such wailers officiated there.
